notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for deterministic service-level exception boundaries in the official IEEE 1516.1 API. The adapter supplies the provider package, baseline FOM, endpoint, logical-time selection, and callback configuration. The scenario verifies invalid resign actions and lookahead, disconnect while joined, ownership cancellation and confirmation boundaries, delete-privilege enforcement, and duplicate named registration. It asserts only standard exception names and public state transitions; it does not assert provider diagnostics, registries, private headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador service calls with deterministic standard exception outcomes
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador service declarations and exception specifications
